units: <cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 28:9">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXVIII</cite> <he>שנת ת׳</he> a trance-like sleep.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17:5">Gen. R. s. 17</cite>, a. e. <he>תַּרְדֵּמַת שינה</he> the torpor of sleep; <he>ת׳ נבואה</he> the trance of prophecy; <he>ת׳ מרמיטה</he>, v. <cite ref="M02715"><he>מרמיטה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17:5">Ib.</cite> <he>ת׳ שטות</he> the torpor of madness.—Pl. <he>תַּרְדֵּמוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17:5">Ib.</cite> <he>שלש ת׳ הן</he> there are three kinds of torpor.
